description: Returns brands in Plendio's catalogue with the number of products each has and the url of its brand page on Plendio. With a query it finds brands whose name contains every word of it (accents ignored), brands that start with the query first; without one it lists the biggest brands. The product counts cover the whole catalogue, not one market. A page holds up to 96 brands.

market.description: Market for the brand page links: dk, se, de or no. Default: the market of the site you connected to.

page.description: Result page of a search, 96 brands per page. Default 1.

query.description: Part of a brand name, e.g. "sony" or "bang olu". Empty lists the biggest brands.

name: list_brands

aliases.description: Other spellings of the name in the catalogue.

products.description: Products of the brand in the catalogue, all markets together.

total.description: How many brands match the query (0 without a query: the biggest brands are listed).

title: List brands
